moves.name: Curse of Knowledge
moves.notes: Always followed by Slap. Always used at the start of combat. Only used while the "Curse of Knowledge" counter is below 3 . Each use increases the counter by + 1 and offers different curse choices on the 1st/2nd/3rd use.

moves.name: Slap
moves.notes: Always followed by Knowledge Overwhelming. After "Curse of Knowledge" has been used 3 times, the branch no longer returns to the curse and starts the loop from this move instead.

moves.name: Ponder
moves.notes: This move also heals Knowledge Demon for 30 x player count HP and grants 2(3) Strength .

enemy.pattern_text:
Shows this enemy's repeating move order. Disintegration X: Take X damage at the end of your turn.
(Stacks additively if selected multiple times) Mind Rot : Draw 1 fewer card at the start of your turn Sloth : You cannot play more than 3 cards per turn Waste Away : Gain 1 less energy at the start of your turn
* Heal is multiplied by player count
